description: Nightly scrape of Awwwards top-5 and Refero design signals per niche. Rotates 3 niches per night per schedule in skills/design-intelligence/_shared/niches.md. Writes to skills/design-intelligence/_feeds/. Logs to ops/reports/design-intelligence-{date}.json.
prompt: Run the nightly design intelligence scraper. Rotate through the niche list in skills/design-intelligence/_shared/niches.md according to the scrape schedule (3 niches per night). For each niche: (1) trigger awwwards-scraper to fetch top 5 sites and extract mechanisms, (2) trigger refero-scraper to extract design token signals, (3) write combined feed to skills/design-intelligence/_feeds/{niche}-latest.md. Archive previous day's feed as {niche}-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md. On error, write to ops/reports/design-intelligence-errors.json and do NOT overwrite the latest feed. Cost guard: max $2.00 per run.
